scoring: A run passes when every pattern matches the final answer, case-insensitive, as in the notebook's grade(). Verify every verify_sql item against the warehouse before the run; the notebook refuses to run on a mismatch. Decoy patterns accept any plain statement that the figure cannot be found, so a model is not failed for wording.

questions.question: How many contract actions on N00024-15-C-2114 fall in fiscal year 2021, and what did they obligate in total?
questions.verify_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, CAST(SUM(CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2))) AS STRING) AS total FROM {schema}.aircarrier_src_2114_contract_transactions WHERE year(to_date(action_date)) + CASE WHEN month(to_date(action_date)) >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 2021

questions.question: What is the largest single obligation action on the Kennedy's detail design and construction contract N00024-15-C-2114: which modification, what amount, and on what date?
questions.verify_sql: SELECT modification_number AS m, CAST(CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS STRING) AS amount, CAST(to_date(action_date) AS STRING) AS d FROM {schema}.aircarrier_src_2114_contract_transactions ORDER BY CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2)) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the largest deobligation on N00024-09-C-2116: which modification, how much, and when?
questions.verify_sql: SELECT modification_number AS m, CAST(CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS STRING) AS amount, CAST(to_date(action_date) AS STRING) AS d FROM {schema}.aircarrier_src_2116_contract_transactions ORDER BY CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2)) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many actions on N00024-09-C-2116 are deobligations (negative obligations)?
questions.verify_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {schema}.aircarrier_src_2116_contract_transactions WHERE CAST(federal_action_obligation AS DECIMAL(20,2)) < 0
